caption:
Toggle a modal with display: none in your machine coding round and the fade you wrote never plays. It just pops in.

Look at the card. While the modal is display: none, there is no box on the page, so the browser has no starting frame to animate from. It switches to block and opacity 1 in the same step, and the transition is skipped.

Fix: keep the box and hide it with opacity: 0 plus visibility: hidden. Opacity fades. visibility: hidden stops clicks, Tab focus and screen readers from reaching the invisible modal, which opacity alone doesn't.

Newer CSS can keep display: none and still fade, using @starting-style with transition-behavior: allow-discrete.

Source: MDN, @starting-style and visibility.
